versions.changelog:
- Initial release of subtitle-download skill.
- Batch-downloads missing subtitles for organized media libraries.
- Uses Subliminal under Podman on Fedora Atomic; ensures exact-matching .srt filenames.
- Handles .ass/.sub subtitle conversion to .srt using ffmpeg.
- Documents current provider limitations and workarounds.
- Details common pitfalls and usage notes for reliable operation.
